name: mlastro-build-button
description: Adds a BUILD button to the status bar that runs the 'dotnet: build' task.

mlastroBuildButton.task.description: Default task label to run when clicking the BUILD button. If it is not found (or is ambiguous across folders), a task picker is shown.

mlastroBuildButton.workspaceFolder.description: Optional workspace folder name to restrict the task search to. Leave empty to search all open folders.
